scope: Standalone YouTube thumbnail; separate from the original video and eight front-page image manifests
export: FFmpeg Lanczos resize to 1280x720 JPEG; no creative edits after generation
prompt: Create one polished YouTube thumbnail for JalRakshak, a local water-supply planning prototype for one hostel caretaker. Use case: ads-marketing. Output intent: a finished wide 16:9 raster thumbnail, target 1280 x 720 pixels, crisp professional finish, opaque background. Design: dark forest green background (#173d37 to #244f46), warm ivory typography (#fafaf3), pale mint accent (#c8e7bb), restrained amber accent. Premium editorial tech aesthetic with bold clean typography and a single beautifully rendered stylized 3D water tank. Layout: left 58% holds text, right 42% holds a large transparent cylindrical water tank with believable mint water, a clearly visible amber reserve threshold around its lower quarter, and water visibly ABOVE that threshold. The tank is conceptual illustration, not a real installation or an app screenshot. Subtle depth and reflected light, readable silhouette at tiny mobile scale, no busy scenery. Exact text, correctly spelled and no additional words: brand 'JalRakshak' near upper left in a bold clean sans serif; dominant giant headline split into three lines 'ACT BEFORE' / 'RESERVE' / 'RUNS LOW', with RESERVE pale mint and other headline lines ivory; a modest pill 'LOCAL PROTOTYPE' near lower left. Use thick large text with generous spacing, no clipping. All important content at least 6% inside edges; keep bottom right clear for YouTube's time badge. Strong visual hierarchy and clear thumbnail-sized readability. Do not include numbers, forecasts, metrics, AWS logos, official logos, awards, people, interfaces, fake screenshots, charts, water-savings claims, alarm icons, photorealistic disaster imagery, tiny text, watermarks or extra copy. Make it attention-grabbing through contrast and clarity, not misleading claims.
